content: LGPD Lei 13.709/2018 Art. 5 I: personal data includes identifiable natural persons; IP in scan logs is typically personal. Art. 9: transparent processing info. Art. 18: confirmation, access, correction, deletion of excessive data, portability. ANPD cookie guide: analytics can often use legitimate interest; consent banners are for non-essential cookies, not a substitute for a privacy notice. Operational v1: public privacy policy, authenticated analytics, hide IP in UI, export/delete logs and admin account deletion. Defer scan-time consent, geo, and auto-retention.
